items.reason: Same agent spelled two ways. The record first writes it in the official title ('Anti-GITR Agonist INCAGN1876') and later as 'INCAGN01876'. Manual §3 says to use the development code 'exactly as first written in the record'. The candidate set is the same in substance.

Inclusion accepts 'WHO grade IV glioblastoma' by histology without an IDH requirement and explicitly allows 'secondary GBM' from prior low-grade glioma. IDH-wildtype is required only on the cIMPACT-NOW molecular route, so the record does not require IDH-wildtype for all entrants (not cns5). This fits C8 'historical'.

note: (1) The agent dictionary must map incagn1876 and incagn01876 to the same moiety. If XL prefers the registered intervention name, use incagn01876; nothing else changes. (2) Not queued, but I depart from both coders: they coded MGMT as an eligibility biomarker, yet inclusion 5 only requires that MGMT status 'must be available', with no particular status. Under manual §5 (eligibility = an entry requirement on the marker), this is not a molecular selection, so I propose any_molecular_selection false. XL should confirm. (3) target_engagement yes (agreed) rests on the Cohort B tumour immune-microenvironment evaluation in the description, with no registered outcome.
